subject: aerospace-materials-1
title: Aerospace Materials I — Assessment Test II (Midterm 2)
note: Assessment Test II of 22 November 2019 (model B) is Part I, a test of 10 questions with four options and one right answer (+0.5 right, -0.15 wrong, 0 blank, the mark never below 0; 5 points), and Part II, one problem of 5 points on a binary phase diagram with four parts (1.2 + 1.3 + 1.3 + 1.2). The 2018 paper has the same ten questions and the same problem. The paper prints no duration: the test takes part of one class session, so 60 minutes is the standard here. The ten questions of the real paper are four on Unit 5 and two on each of Units 4, 6 and 7; the simulator keeps that mix.
